lines.text: Paul tells Timothy to appeal to an older man as to a father and treat younger men as brothers.
A widow truly in need and left alone puts her hope in her neighbors and prays night and day.
Anyone who does not provide for his own household has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
A widow to be enrolled must be at least seventy years old, faithful to her husband, and known for good deeds.
Paul advises younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, so the adversary has no occasion for slander.
